title: W6 Retire: drop the guards, the 300 cap special case, circles.is_space_primary and the Space Circle code and tests

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: Space circles become a Community wall; thread plan /mnt/project-files/community-wall/PLAN.md

detail:
Last. Drops circles_space_primary_guard, circles_one_space_primary, the cap branch, the column and its type, space_circle_optouts, the Space Circle code paths, pgTAP tests and probes (owner phrases per pinned probe, one code block, run all probes first). Never before W5 is verified in production.

W6 retire: 20270346029600 (additive, run first) copies every retired Space Circle slug to public.retired_space_circles for the old-link redirect and rewrites the two Collective cross-listing functions without the flag. 20270346029700 (run after the code is live) drops circles.is_space_primary, circles_space_primary_guard, circles_one_space_primary, the 300 cap arm, ensure_space_circle, enrol_in_space_circle, sync_space_circle_roster, the three trigger functions and space_circle_optouts. App: no Circle lists its Space's calendar (arm 3 retired), no Space Circle shelf, kind, carve, cap, host line, handoff or delete guard; the Menswork finder leads with the founding circle.
